behavioral_effects: AGENTS.md Hard boundaries now requires checker agents to verify against sources rather than the governance briefing, decorrelating doer and checker failure modes
compatibility_impact: None - guidance for review workflows, no code or config touched
reason: The governance lens creates a correlated-failure mode: an implementing agent and its checker reading the same briefing inherit the same wrong curated claim, and the check approves the mistake. Decorrelating the checker - it must read the diff, neighboring code, and actual imports rather than the summary the doer consumed - is the cheapest counter, identified in the accuracy review and adopted as plan Phase 6 item 7
rollback: git revert restores the previous AGENTS.md
summary: AGENTS.md: checker agents verify against sources, not the governance briefing
